description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan, adding {C}{C}.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Glint-Sleeve Artisan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
